extracted.intended_audience: prospective fellows/nominees, nominators, grantseekers, media, and the general public interested in the MacArthur Fellows program
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page describing the MacArthur Fellows Program's purpose, public communications (press/media), and program staff. The page communicates program mission, descriptive language about fellows, and program values rather than a detailed application or scoring rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program mission — celebrate and inspire creative potential
rubrics_metrics.description: The MacArthur Fellows Program "celebrates and inspires the creative potential of individuals through no-strings-attached fellowships."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement defines the program's central purpose: to recognize and enable individuals' creative capacities. It implies selection favors individuals whose creativity the program can celebrate and whose potential the award can help inspire or advance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship terms — no-strings-attached
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowships are described as "no-strings-attached fellowships."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates award funds are unrestricted and recipients have freedom in how they use the grant. This is a program feature/constraint rather than a scoring criterion, but it defines the nature of the support offered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection emphasis — extraordinary creativity and breadth/depth
rubrics_metrics.description: Press language refers to the class as "24 Extraordinarily Creative People" and quotes Cecilia Conrad: "This year’s class of MacArthur Fellows is an extraordinary group of individuals who collectively reflect the breadth and depth of American creativity."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggests selection emphasizes extraordinary originality and that cohorts are chosen to represent a wide range of creative fields and expressions (breadth and depth). Implies interdisciplinary and cross-domain selection rather than a narrow disciplinary focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program value — impact and inspiration
rubrics_metrics.description: A program review is titled "Review Affirms Impact and Inspiration of MacArthur Fellows Program," and includes the quote: "We are proud of the Fellows Program and its impact on the lives of not just those selected but people all over the world."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the program values both the demonstrable impact of Fellows' work and the inspirational effect the program has beyond awardees. Selection and post-award communications emphasize societal influence and inspirational reach.
